description: This file implements network-related utilities for Telegram integration, including DNS resolution, proxy configuration, fallback handling, and fetch request management with custom dispatchers.

methods.name: normalizeDnsResultOrder
methods.description: Normalizes DNS result order string to specific allowed values or null.

methods.name: createDnsResultOrderLookup
methods.description: Creates a DNS lookup function that respects the specified DNS result order.

methods.name: buildTelegramConnectOptions
methods.description: Builds connection options for DNS resolution based on parameters.

methods.name: shouldBypassEnvProxyForTelegramApi
methods.description: Determines if environment proxy should be bypassed for Telegram API based on NO_PROXY settings.

methods.name: hasEnvHttpProxyForTelegramApi
methods.description: Checks if an environment HTTP proxy is configured for Telegram API.

methods.name: resolveTelegramDispatcherPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the dispatcher policy and mode based on parameters like auto family selection, DNS order, proxy usage, and IPv4 forcing.

methods.name: withPinnedLookup
methods.description: Adds pinned hostname lookup configuration to options if specified.

methods.name: createTelegramDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a dispatcher (Agent or proxy) based on the provided policy.

methods.name: withDispatcherIfMissing
methods.description: Adds dispatcher to RequestInit if not already present.

methods.name: resolveWrappedFetch
methods.description: Resolves fetch implementation, possibly wrapping the provided fetch.

methods.name: logResolverNetworkDecisions
methods.description: Logs network decision parameters such as auto family selection and DNS order.

methods.name: collectErrorCodes
methods.description: Collects error codes from an error object and its causes.

methods.name: formatErrorCodes
methods.description: Formats collected error codes into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: shouldUseTelegramTransportFallback
methods.description: Determines if fallback should be used based on error rules.

methods.name: resolveTelegramTransport
methods.description: Resolves a Telegram network transport with fallback and proxy handling.

methods.name: resolveTelegramFetch
methods.description: Resolves a fetch function configured for Telegram network requests.

methods.name: resolveTelegramApiBase
methods.description: Returns the base URL for Telegram Bot API, optionally from a custom root.
